personality_one_liner: A dense, professional, and trustworthy iOS-native dashboard maximizing legibility for financial data and inventory tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for dense data blocks. Maintain clean iOS native layout and pad safe areas.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use glass for sticky sticky headers over scrolling content.
Apply to pinned chip filter rows (like All/Pending/Completed) on list pages.
dont's: Do not apply glass to data rows, simple forms, or primary interactive cards.
Do not blur entire body content sections.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A commanding overview showing total sales, profit, payables/receivables, and quick inventory alerts.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the widget layout.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'No data logged today' (only if brand new).
states.error: Error toast with a 'Retry Data Fetch' inline button.

screens.layout: Use a sticky header displaying 'Soneja Electronics' logo and user avatar. Below, 2-column grid for primary metrics (Sales, Profit, Payables, Receivables) with bold tabular numbers. Follow with horizontally scrolling 'Low Stock Alerts' cards. Include a glassmorphism sticky header if the view scrolls.

screens.name: Sales Orders
screens.purpose: List view of all invoices to dealers with part-payment and aging tracking.

states.empty: Empty clipboard illustration + 'No Sales Orders Found'.
states.error: Message 'Failed to load orders' + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass filter chip row at the top (All, Unpaid, Partial, Cleared). List items use an iOS-native `ListTile` approach: Order Ref on top left, Dealer Name on bottom left, total INR on top right, and a status badge (paid/unpaid/partial) on bottom right. Floating Action Button (glass over brandTertiary) to create a new order.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Live catalog of SKUs/Models, quantities, and GST-inclusive costing.

states.empty: Empty box illustration + 'Inventory is empty. Add Products.'

screens.layout: Search bar at the top followed by an alphabetical list of products. Each row displays the TV model thumbnail, SKU name, Qty on hand in bold, and a low-stock badge if applicable.

screens.name: Dealer Network
screens.purpose: Directory of shop owners/dealers with quick action buttons for communication.
screens.layout: Card-based layout (single column) for each dealer. Show Shop Name, Contact Person, Area. Include two outline button actions per card: 'Call' and 'WhatsApp'. Avatar initials on the left.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Logistics warehouse background for dashboard hero

empty_clipboard.alt: Empty clipboard for zero orders or tasks

tv_product_placeholder.alt: Smart TV placeholder for inventory SKUs

empty_box.alt: Empty box illustration for zero inventory

user_avatar.alt: Indian businessman portrait for user avatar

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality layout guidelines: use native spacing rhythms and avoid heavy material card shadows.
Implement dense, highly scannable list structures (e.g., Sales Orders) with tabular numbers for INR values to ease reading for the business owner.
The app uses a teal/blue theme per the client's explicit request. Ensure the teal colors do not wash out; adhere to the defined `brand` and `surface` tokens.
Place chip rows for filtering (e.g., All/Pending/Cleared) inside a sticky header with `expo-glass-effect` or `expo-blur` when content scrolls underneath.
Any hero images or backgrounds (like the dashboard warehouse background) MUST use a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim so text stays readable.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Stick to weight 400-500 max for all typography, using size rather than boldness for hierarchy.
Empty states must use the provided real images (clipboard, empty box) mapped with the correct text labels and a primary CTA.
